engine: Saisei's HOMEPAGE title reveal — the big serif word is drawn as OUTLINE STROKES that trace the letter contours (SVG stroke-dashoffset full->0), then the FILL fades in, so the title writes itself onto the dark hero before becoming solid. Different from mask-up-title (which RISES a project title from a baseline); this one DRAWS the homepage title in place. Harvested from D_saisei (S5b; o_028-o_044).

measured_teardown.move: an <svg><text> with the title: stroke = cream, no fill, stroke-dasharray = path length so stroke-dashoffset animates length->0 (the outline traces on, ~1067ms, ease-out); then a fill-coloured copy fades in over the back half. The glyphs do NOT move — they draw in place.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei homepage: SAISEI outline strokes first appear at o_028 (~5%), trace to ~55% by o_034, full outline + dark fill by o_036; fill lightens with the bg fade-in.

text.what: the title word (or data-text on the target).

entry: StrokeDrawTitle.create(target, opts) -> { svg, play(o), set(p), reset(), destroy }. Injects an <svg> with an outline <text> (strokes on via stroke-dashoffset) + a fill <text> (fades in over the back half). play() runs it; set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub; reset() back to un-drawn.
law: SVG stroke-dashoffset + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> shown filled. GSAP optional (built-in rAF power2 fallback). The fill is baked into set(p) over the back half (p>0.5). owns_pin false.
gate_mode: triggered SVG text (no , not scroll) — the wheel gate doesn't apply. Verify the outline traces (dashoffset len->0) then fill fades, smoothly.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO title — the outline strokes trace the letter contours (dashoffset 1573->0) and the fill fades in over the back half (p0.5=0, p0.7=0.4, p1=1). At set(0.55) the word reads as thin outline strokes with the fill barely up (matches Saisei o_030-o_034: outline-only letters on the dark hero). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 0/120 long frames (0.0%), 59.9fps.
